tsconfigFile_comment: TS7 workaround: typescript@7's CJS entry exports only version/versionMajorMinor, so Stryker's sandbox TSConfigPreprocessor crashes calling ts.parseConfigFileTextToJson.
Pointing tsconfigFile at a path absent from the project makes that rewrite step no-op, which is safe because vitest transpiles this repo without the project references the rewrite exists to fix.

Revisit when @stryker-mutator/core's TSConfigPreprocessor supports typescript >= 7: then point tsconfigFile at ./tsconfig.json (or delete both keys — but note the option DEFAULTS to 'tsconfig.json', which exists here, so merely deleting tsconfigFile today re-triggers the crash).
